scope: Pinned real TS and Go Message Box handlers/authentication with SQLite, TS AuthSocket, client-side Go HTTP polling, funded controlled BRC-100 wallets, and Mongo-backed MessageBox advertisement service. The separately identified Go SQLite compatibility adapter normalizes byte arrays before authentication signing and atomically persists per-recipient payment replay claims.
network: Loopback controlled services; no production credentials, public-mainnet submission, FCM or device lease.

assertions.unauthenticated-denied: An unauthenticated list request cannot read messages.
assertions.encrypted-delivery: A recipient decrypts exactly the submitted payload and observes the authenticated sender.
assertions.identity-isolation: Another identity cannot list or acknowledge the recipient's message.
assertions.duplicate-rejected: A repeated message ID never adds a second message.
assertions.permission-denial: A recipient block prevents storage; restoring permission permits delivery.
assertions.unpaid-denied: A positive recipient fee prevents an unpaid message from being stored.
assertions.paid-internalization: A real funded sender creates a BRC-29 payment, the server stores it, and the receiving wallet internalizes the exact output.
assertions.payment-replay-rejected: One payment cannot fund two distinct message requests.
assertions.restart-recovery: Within five bounded reads after complete server restart, the recipient sees every unacknowledged message.
assertions.acknowledgment-durable: A recipient acknowledgment removes the message after restart.
assertions.http-auth-replay-rejected: An exact signed HTTP application request cannot execute twice.
assertions.live-delivery: An authenticated recipient receives a new message using its declared TS WebSocket or Go HTTP polling transport.
assertions.discovery: A real MessageBox topic manager admits a signed advertisement, a Mongo-backed lookup resolves its outpoint and revocation removes it.
assertions.payment-replay-after-acknowledgment: A payment remains non-reusable after recipient acknowledgment and complete server restart.
